name: The Found Magic
storyline: We have become aware that each of the Crystals bringing balance to the universe have their own unique powers. The Crystal of blue allows one to create alternate worlds and bring dreams into reality. You have been granted the opportunity to possess this power yourself by an entity known only as The Watcher. They have sent their 4 disciples to test your worthiness. While The Watcher spectates your adventure through the realms of fantasy, you can't help but shake the feeling the disciples are up to something sinister in the background...
summary: The Found Magic is a 34 map MBF21 mapset for Doom 2, created by a large group of mappers, and is the sequel to 2023's The Quinary Conundrum.
